notes: Replies to your messages come through the game. When the people who make the game answer, you hear it on reaching the match list, and the "Replies to your messages" option reads your message and the reply side by side. No email, no leaving the game.

notes_by_language.pt_BR: As respostas aos seus recados chegam pelo jogo. Quando quem faz o jogo responder, você ouve ao chegar na lista de partidas, e a opção "Respostas aos seus recados" lê o seu recado e a resposta lado a lado. Sem email, sem sair do jogo.
notes_by_language.en_US: Replies to your messages come through the game. When the people who make the game answer, you hear it on reaching the match list, and the "Replies to your messages" option reads your message and the reply side by side. No email, no leaving the game.
